```yaml
name: CDK Source Connector Compatibility Test

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/base/**'
      - 'airbyte-cdk/python/airbyte-cdk/sources/**'
      - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/**'
      - 'tools/bin/bulk-cdk/**'
      - '.github/workflows/cdk-source-connector-compatibility-test.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  test-source-connectors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r airbyte-cdk/python/airbyte-cdk/sources/requirements.txt
          pip install -r airbyte-cdk/python/airbyte-cdk/sources/requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Get certified source connectors
        id: get-connectors
        run: |
          CONNECTORS=$(tools/bin/bulk-cdk/get-certified-connectors.sh sources)
          echo "connectors=$CONNECTORS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run compatibility tests
        if: steps.get-connectors.outputs.connectors != ''
        run: |
          CONNECTORS="${{ steps.get-connectors.outputs.connectors }}"
          for connector in $CONNECTORS; do
            echo "Testing source connector: $connector"
            # Assuming a standard test command structure for CDK source connectors
            # Adjust the command below based on the actual test runner used in the repo
            python -m pytest airbyte-cdk/python/airbyte-cdk/sources/tests/ -k "$connector" -v --junitxml=test-results/source-${connector}.xml || true
          done

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: test-results/*.xml
          flags: source-connectors
          name: cdk-source-connector-compatibility
```
